name: eizport/eizport
description: Export and import WordPress content as .wxrz bundles.

scripts-descriptions.lint: PHP syntax check of every file.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: WordPress Coding Standards and PHP 7.4+ compatibility.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Fix what PHPCS can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.test: PHPUnit tests (loads the WordPress site the plugin is installed in; set WP_LOAD for another).
scripts-descriptions.make-pot: Write languages/eizport.pot (PHP strings and the built screens': run npm run build first).
scripts-descriptions.check-pot: Fail when languages/eizport.pot is out of date.
scripts-descriptions.check: Lint, PHPCS, tests and the translation template.
